skill.name: sent-analytics
skill.description: Queries Sent phone-number capabilities and aggregate messaging, deliverability, and contact analytics with the Sent MCP tools. Use when a user asks for number lookup, line or channel capability, messages sent, delivery rate, contact growth, dashboard metrics, period comparisons, or date-bounded trends. Use messaging-performance-analyzer for message-level evidence and root-cause diagnosis.
skill.summary: Query Sent number capabilities and compare aggregate messaging, deliverability, and contact trends.
skill.author: sentdm

content.value_statement: Messaging teams need consistent metrics for volume, deliverability, contacts, and number capabilities. This skill queries Sent analytics and explains trends within defined periods.
actual_capabilities: Looks up formatting, type, routing, and available capabilities for a supplied phone number.
Queries aggregate sent-message volume for an explicit date range and timezone.
Reviews aggregate acceptance, delivery, failure, and unknown outcomes when the Sent response provides them.
Queries aggregate contact metrics and supports date-bounded contact growth analysis.
Compares periods while keeping organization, Sender Profile, timezone, channel, and aggregation grain consistent.
limitations: Requires access to the Sent MCP tools through client-managed OAuth.
Does not prove consent, ownership, identity, or permission from a phone number lookup.
Does not inspect message-level records or diagnose root causes.
Cannot infer delivered status from accepted or sent status.

use_cases.title: Review Campaign Delivery
use_cases.description: Measure sent volume and delivery outcomes for a defined campaign period and timezone.

use_cases.title: Track Contact Growth
use_cases.description: Compare aggregate contact totals across consistent periods for the same organization and Sender Profile.

use_cases.title: Check Number Capabilities
use_cases.description: Review available formatting, type, routing, and channel signals before planning a messaging workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Number
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up this phone number: [masked number]. Summarize its formatting, type, routing, and available messaging capabilities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a basic number capability check.

prompt_templates.title: Review Delivery Metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Sent delivery metrics from [start date] through [end date] in [timezone]. Report sent, accepted, delivered, failed, and unknown states separately.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a date-bounded deliverability summary.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Periods
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare messages sent, delivery rate, and contact totals for [period one] and [period two]. Keep the organization, Sender Profile, timezone, channel, and grain consistent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use to identify changes between comparable periods.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Trend
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze weekly messaging and contact trends from [start date] through [end date] in [timezone]. Identify notable changes without claiming unsupported operational causes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced multi-metric trend review.

output_examples.input: Review delivery performance for August in UTC.
output: Sent volume increased compared with the previous equivalent period.
Delivered, failed, accepted, and unknown outcomes remain separately labeled.
The aggregate dashboard identifies changes but does not establish their operational cause.

output_examples.input: Can this number receive text messages?
output_examples.output: The lookup reports the available number type, routing, formatting, and capability signals. These signals do not prove ownership, consent, or permission to message.

output_examples.input: Compare contact growth for the last two quarters.
output_examples.output: The comparison uses the same organization, Sender Profile, timezone, channel, and quarterly grain. It reports contact totals and the observed change for each period.

best_practices: Provide an explicit date range and timezone for every dashboard request.
Compare periods with the same organization, Sender Profile, channel, timezone, and aggregation grain.
Mask phone numbers and request only the aggregate data needed for the analysis.
anti_patterns: Do not treat number capability as proof of consent, identity, ownership, or messaging permission.
Do not combine accepted, sent, delivered, failed, and unknown states into one result.
Do not claim a root cause from aggregate dashboard changes alone.

faq.question: Which Sent metrics can this skill query?
faq.answer: It can query sent-message volume, aggregate deliverability outcomes, contact metrics, and available phone-number capability signals.

faq.question: Does the skill require Sent credentials?
faq.answer: It uses client-managed OAuth through the Sent MCP connection. It should never request tokens, API keys, authorization headers, client IDs, or secrets.

faq.question: Can it compare two reporting periods?
faq.answer: Yes. Comparisons should use matching organization, Sender Profile, timezone, channel, date structure, and aggregation grain.

faq.question: Can a number lookup confirm consent?
faq.answer: No. Capability data does not establish consent, ownership, identity, or permission to message.

faq.question: Can it diagnose delivery failures?
faq.answer: No. Use messaging-performance-analyzer for message-level evidence, error clustering, funnel analysis, and root-cause diagnosis.

faq.question: How does the skill protect sensitive data?
faq.answer: It directs the assistant to mask phone numbers, prefer aggregates, and omit unnecessary contact, KYC, account, and message-body data.
